back: Requests: what the scheduler reserves (placement) and the CPU share under contention. Limits: the runtime ceiling enforced by cgroups.

front: Hitting the CPU limit vs the memory limit
back: CPU: throttled (paused within each 100 ms CFS period), higher latency. Memory: OOMKilled by the kernel, exit code 137.
Guaranteed: every container requests == limits for CPU and memory. BestEffort: no requests/limits anywhere. Burstable: everything else. Eviction order: BestEffort, Burstable, Guaranteed.
LimitRange: per-container defaults, min and max in a namespace (applied at admission). ResourceQuota: total caps for the namespace (requests, limits, object counts).

front: Where do quota rejections show up?
back: On the ReplicaSet (or Job/StatefulSet) as `FailedCreate` events, e.g. `exceeded quota`. No Pending pod is created.

Filter (hard constraints: resources, affinity, taints, spread, volumes) -> Score (preferences, LeastAllocated...) -> Reserve/Permit -> Bind. No feasible node: try preemption, else Pending with a FailedScheduling event.
`NoSchedule` (keep new pods out), `PreferNoSchedule` (soft), `NoExecute` (also evict running pods, optionally after `tolerationSeconds`).
Taints repel pods; tolerations allow a pod onto a tainted node; nodeSelector/node affinity attract pods. Dedicated nodes need taint + affinity.
Pods get tolerations for `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready` and `unreachable` (`NoExecute`) with `tolerationSeconds: 300`, so pods on a dead node are evicted after ~5 minutes.
Limits voluntary disruptions (drain, autoscaler) for selected pods via `minAvailable` or `maxUnavailable` (prefer `maxUnavailable: 1`). The Eviction API returns 429 when a PDB would be violated.
`kubectl cordon` marks a node unschedulable. `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` cordons and evicts pods via the Eviction API, respecting PDBs. `uncordon` reverses it.

Integer priority for pods. A pending higher-priority pod can evict lower-priority pods to fit. `preemptionPolicy: Never` = queue priority only. Built-ins: `system-cluster-critical`, `system-node-critical`.

Heap (bounded by `--max-old-space-size`, default sized from the cgroup limit on recent Node) + off-heap (Buffers, native, stacks). Set heap to ~75% of the limit. Heap OOM = exit 134; cgroup OOM = 137.
Collects current CPU/memory from kubelets and serves `metrics.k8s.io` for `kubectl top` and the HPA. No history (use Prometheus). On kind add `--kubelet-insecure-tls`.
